notes.golden-seed: 45 entries. The DLC adds no Golden Seeds: wiki.gg and Fextralife have no Shadow of the Erdtree acquisition section and third-party totals (45) match the base-game count.
notes.sacred-tear: 12 entries, all base game. The DLC adds no Sacred Tears; the Realm of Shadow uses Scadutree Fragments and Revered Spirit Ashes instead.
notes.revered-spirit-ash: wiki.gg states 25 and its list sums to 25. IGN's DLC checklist says 24; the discrepancy is noted rather than resolved.
notes.smithing-stone: Entries include fixed pickups and enemy-drop leads from Fextralife. Merchant (infinite-stock) rows are excluded. Quantity defaults to 1 when the source does not state one; quantityStated records this.
notes.somber-smithing-stone: Same method as smithing-stone. Ancient Dragon Smithing Stones are outside the requested tier range and are not in this ledger.
notes.glovewort: Grave and Ghost Glovewort [1]-[9]. DLC pickups are included where Fextralife lists a Shadow of the Erdtree section.
notes.great-glovewort: Great Grave Glovewort and Great Ghost Glovewort, including 9 DLC pickups (6 Great Grave + 3 Great Ghost). Two Cerulean Coast Great Grave pickups are added from IGN's DLC guide because Fextralife omits them; the 6+3 total matches IGN's stated count.
notes.scadutree-fragment: wiki.gg list sums to exactly 50, the stated DLC total.

entries.sourceText: Sealed Tunnel: A total of 5 can be found inside the dungeon. Map Link In the hidden chamber past the Site of Grace, drop off the ledge into the lower section and check the alcove in the back for the first stone. In the same chamber, head west to find a chest. Dispel the illusory wall behind the chest to reveal a lift but don't ride it. Instead, drop down the ledges on the left to find the second stone. At the bottom of the lift chamber, look to the south and dispel two illusory walls to reveal a large cavern with overgrown roots. Navigate the roots to reach the tunnel in the east and drop down an opening on the right to find the third stone in the back. Beware of the exploding Abnormal Stone Clusters. In the same chamber with the exploders, look for a set of wooden stairs. The fourth stone can be found on a wall next to these stairs. Still in the same chamber, check the wall opposite the stairs. Beware the exploder hidden behind crates and barrels. Hit the wall to reveal a deep pit with roots strewn across. Drop down to the second root and check the ledge in the corner for the final stone.

entries.sourceText: Auriza Hero's Grave: A total of 4 can be found in the dungeon. Map Link In the first Chariot Hall, drop down the openings on either side just before the second ramp and then check the eastern wall in the bottom room. Beware the multiple Basilisks that emerge from the ground as you approach. From the first glovewort, head west and up the steps and then turn right in the next corridor. Follow the path towards a second Chariot Hall where two Chariots are running side by side with a short delay between them. The second glovewort can be found shortly after exiting into this hall, right down the middle before the second ramp. In the same large hall, head all the way to the bottom where there is a large pit. Look down to find some wooden beams you can drop onto. Navigate your way to the lowest beam and then head south towards an archway with a ladder in the back. Head up the ladder and you will end up in another hall with a single Chariot. Wait for it to run down the ramp and then head up and turn right into a chamber with a flamethrower pillar. The third glovewort can be found behind this pillar. From the flamethrower pillar, head back into the last Chariot hall and head all the way down to the bottom. Enter the corridor on the left and then take another left to find a lift which will take you up to a chamber where the flamethrower pillar is raised (if you have previously hit it). If the pillar is active, it will be spewing flames into the northern corridor. Wait for breaks in between spews and head inside. There is an alcove on the right where you can safely wait for another break before heading to the end of the corridor. Turn left at the end to find the final glovewort just before the path leads back to the large double Chariot Hall.
